## Reconciliation outcome

- **No claim is already fixed on `main`.** All seven target pages still contain the stale source text identified by their legacy PRs.
- The smallest safe fresh replacements are the PR diffs for **#289, #290, #292, and #293**.
- For **#288**, retain the five substantive corrections but fix the new 503 JSON envelope and omit the false `/health` exemption.
- For **#291**, retain every correction except the false “missing `AUTOMEM_API_URL` returns 500” sentence.
- For **#294**, retain the dimension/provider corrections, but narrow history-mode wording to not-yet-valid and expired memories; it does not restore archived candidates.
